title: Arcane Crafting
body:
# ✦ Arcane Crafting ✦

**Arcane Crafting** is a datapack for Minecraft 1.12.2-26.2.x that adds crafting recipes 
for items that are normally uncraftable — mods required, just drop it in your world!

---

## 📦 How to install

1. Download the .jar file
2. Open your Minecraft mods folder
3. Drop the .jar file there
4. Open the game and enjoy! ✅


## 🔍 View all recipes in-game

Want to see all recipes visually inside the game?
Install **JEI (Just Enough Items)** — it shows every crafting recipe including ones from datapacks!

- Download JEI: [modrinth.com/mod/jei](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei)
- Requires **Fabric**

---

## ⚗️ What can you craft?

### 🏆 Rare & Legendary Items
- **Enchanted Golden Apple** — 8 Gold Blocks + Apple
- **Totem of Undying** — Gold + Emerald + Chorus Fruit
- **Elytra** — Phantom Membranes + Feathers
- **Trident** — Prismarine Shards + Heart of the Sea
- **Dragon Egg** — End Stone + Dragon Breath
- **Nether Star** — Wither Skulls + Soul Sand
- **Heavy Core** — Iron Blocks + Breeze Rod + Netherite

### 🐴 Utility Items
- **Saddle** — Leather + Iron Ingots
- **Name Tag** — Gold + String + Paper
- **Bundle** — 8 Leather + Chest
- **Sponge** — Dried Kelp + Slime Balls
- **Heart of the Sea** — Nautilus Shells + Prismarine Crystals

### 🛡️ Horse Armor
- **Iron Horse Armor** — Iron Ingots
- **Golden Horse Armor** — Gold Ingots
- **Diamond Horse Armor** — Diamonds

### 💀 Mob Heads
- **Creeper Head** — Gunpowder + TNT
- **Zombie Head** — Rotten Flesh + Bones
- **Skeleton Skull** — Bones + Arrows
- **Piglin Head** — Gold Nuggets + Porkchop
- **Dragon Head** — Ender Pearls + Obsidian + Dragon Breath
- **Wither Skeleton Skull** — Bones + Coal + Soul Sand

---

## ✅ Compatible with
- Minecraft Java Edition 1.12.2-26.2
- Singleplayer & Multiplayer servers
- Mods needed!
